h: Seeing the Gift Within Blessing and Rebuke

p: were given as a gift to the world," etc.;
about which the term "giving" is written,
even the opposite of the blessing
and it is only for your good,
did I give them blessings and curses,
but to make known to them
that they should choose it," etc.
And this is as it says (Devarim 30:7):
upon your enemies and upon those who hate you," etc.
similar to what it says in the Zohar Chadash (Parashas Balak)
"And I will give men in your stead,
and nations in place of your soul":
puts a non-Jew in his place;
And it is only to frighten him,
so that he will choose the good way,
And Hashem Yisbarach will make clear
that in truth our will is
and the subjugation to the kingdoms" (Berachos 17a).
And this is the meaning of
"upon your enemies and upon those who hate you":
and the nations of the world,
who are the ones responsible for this,
for through the evil power within them
into the heart of Yisrael as well;
"And the goat will carry upon itself
and this is as it says
which is the middah of Malchus:
which is the crown of kingship.
there are mentioned "chaos and void" and "darkness,"
and as the deeds of the wicked;
for Hashem Yisbarach will make clear
that the deeds of the wicked
come about through the four kingdoms.
when they were of one heart
it is said in the plural,
for they were not found so much
the need for blessing upon Yisrael
and the opposite upon the nations of the world,
so that they choose the good way,
and they are not yet on so high a level
for this the plural is written:
as one man with one heart,
to see in the present, at once,
which is the crown of kingship,
which is not yet on so high a level,
it is said in the plural.
about which the holy Zohar expounds
the pasuk "On the day that He gives rest," etc.,
how everything is for the good.
in the midst of the hard labor,
for they see that it is for the good
and that it is a gift from Hashem Yisbarach,
